title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Position: Full time / Permanent - Hereford

Our Client

We are delighted to be working with this small multi-disciplined consultancy business based in Hereford, assisting in their search for a driven Accounts Assistant to join their expanding team. The company aim to help SME businesses grow by providing proactive and cost-effective advice.

This is a great opportunity for an experienced Accounts Assistant to develop and progress their career further in a dynamic team.

You will be supporting the Client Manager and the rest of the team in their provision of accountancy based services to a wide variety of businesses across different sectors.

- AAT Qualified
- 2-3 years' experience in an accounting practice
- Interact well with clients and other staff members
- Strong mathematical and administrative skills
- The successful candidate should be ambitious and progression is available for the right person.
- Good communication skills are essential, both verbal and written
- Ideally have experience of working with Xero Accounting Software

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant (6-Month FTC)
Salary: Up to £28k FTE
Location: Ross-on-Wye (hybrid, 2 days per week from home once established)

We're looking for an Accounts Assistant who can hit the ground running in a busy finance team on a 6-month fixed-term contract. - Reconciling supplier accounts and resolving queries
- Managing daily bank reconciliations and cashbook activities
- Supporting credit control and debt collection processes
- Maintaining accurate customer and supplier records

About you:
- Previous experience in an accounts payable or finance assistant role
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
- Confident communicator with excellent stakeholder management skills
- Comfortable working with financial systems and Excel
- Proactive approach with a continuous improvement mindset

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

title: Accounts Assistant - Hybrid Working
description:
Exciting opportunity in Ross-on-Wye for an Accounts Assistant to join an active and busy accounts function in a nationally recognised company, on a full time, 6-month fixed term contract.

You will support the Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable function, assisting with supplier payments, bank reconciliations, credit control, customer and supplier queries, and maintaining accurate financial records. Full training on the role and systems will be provided.

Whilst this is offered as a fixed-term contract, we regularly see temporary staff secure permanent opportunities within the business with strong development routes internally.

Key Responsibilities
- Process supplier invoices accurately and within deadlines.
- Support supplier payment runs and maintain supplier accounts.
- Reconcile supplier statements and resolve invoice or payment queries.
- Process daily banking transactions and complete bank reconciliations.
- Assist with month-end journals and financial reconciliations.
- Support credit control by monitoring aged debt and chasing overdue payments.
- Respond to customer and supplier queries in a professional manner.
- Maintain accurate financial records, documentation and account data.
- Work with colleagues to identify and support process improvements.

Key Attributes
- Previous finance or accounts experience
- Reliable, team player
- Confident communicator

Hours: Monday - Friday, 8:30am - 5pm (1hr lunch) - 37.5h pw with option to work from home up to 1-2 days per week once fully trained and settled.

Salary: £25,200 - £28,000 benefits including:
- Hybrid working
- Free parking
- EAP Programme.
- 25 days holiday PLUS bank holidays + annual leave purchase scheme (pro rata for temp or part time)
- Birthday day off.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper

Hereford

Salary DOE

Autograph Recruitment are working with a successful accountancy practice in Hereford to recruit an experienced Bookkeeper to join their team.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working independently, managing client work and taking ownership of accurate, timely bookkeeping and VAT.

The Role

You will manage bookkeeping for a varied client portfolio, including:
- Processing invoices and transactions through to trial balance
- Completing bank and control account reconciliations
- Preparing and submitting VAT returns
- Resolving queries and discrepancies
- Liaising with clients on bookkeeping and VAT matters
- Maintaining accurate, well-organised records for accounts and tax work
- Working with cloud accounting software including Xero and QuickBooks

About You

We re looking for someone with:
- Previous bookkeeping experience, ideally within practice
- A strong understanding of double-entry bookkeeping
- VAT experience
- Confidence using cloud accounting software
- Good client communication skills
- A proactive, organised approach and the ability to work independently
- AAT qualified, part-qualified or QBE candidates are all welcome.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Payroll Administrator Ledbury Salary up to £30,000

My client is looking for an assistant to join their payroll team, which is located at the Ledbury office. The payroll bureau at Ledbury looks after the payrolls for the clients over several offices

This is an office-based role and will be based on working 5 days a week (37.5 hours) in the Ledbury office.

Key responsibilities

They are looking for an organised individual to assist their busy payroll team. The individual will be responsible for the payroll duties to allow the members of Ledbury team to focus on other areas of work.

The individual will be processing payrolls in a timely and efficient manner, for review by the payroll manger. The role will also include communicating with clients and HMRC, ensuring payroll deadlines are met and completing auto enrolment duties.

Your profile
- Excellent communication skills
- Good IT skills, particularly in Excel and outlook.
- Efficient and organised
- Team player
- Good eye for detail

For further information, please contact Emma Hughes

By responding, we will register you as a candidate with Seymour John Limited. To understand how we will use your personal data, please read the Privacy Policy on our website.
